title: CRV skill context budgets (v1)
description: Configuration for standards/scripts/check_budgets.py. The config is itself schema-validated so that a typo in a budget key silently disables a check instead of failing loudly -- which is the failure mode that makes budget enforcement worthless.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors offer completion.

skill-md.description: Hard budgets for the SKILL.md body. The whole file is loaded into context the moment the skill activates, so every line competes with the user's actual task.

max-lines.description: Spec guidance: keep SKILL.md under 500 lines.

max-characters.description: Cheap, tokenizer-independent proxy; catches long single-line tables that pass the line check.

max-tokens.description: Spec guidance: under ~5000 tokens of instructions.

reference-files.description: Soft budget for files under references/. These load on demand, so they may be longer than SKILL.md -- but a reference file large enough to blow the context window when pulled in is a file that should have been split.

encoding.description: Token counts are an approximation: no harness publishes its production tokenizer. cl100k_base is a stable, offline, widely understood yardstick. The number is a budget, not a measurement of any specific model.

on-unavailable.description: What to do when tiktoken is not importable or its encoding files cannot be downloaded. 'skip' reports the token check as skipped and does not fail; 'error' fails; 'estimate' falls back to a characters-per-token heuristic and labels the result as estimated. Never silently pass.

estimate-characters-per-token.description: Divisor used only when on-unavailable is 'estimate'.

enforcement.description: Severity per maturity level. Drafts warn so that authoring is not blocked by a budget before the content exists; stable fails because a stable skill is one other people depend on.

exemptions.description: Escape hatch with a paper trail. Each entry must name the file, the budget, and a reason -- an exemption nobody can explain is a budget nobody meant.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the exempt file.
